issues.description: Handle publication before/after KeyboardInterrupt or SystemExit and metadata-lock exit interruption left a live lease after catchable failure. Exact own-session cleanup now covers these exits, preserves evidence and rethrows BaseException.

new_boundary_verification: Actual child os._exit after initial lease before handle keeps lease live, blocks immediate attach and permits a new session only after normal expiry.
